facts.text: John and his team faced tough opponents during the season, which motivated them to improve.

evidence.quote: Cool! Sounds like you guys had some tough games. How did you handle those?
We faced tough opponents but that's what drives us to get better.

facts.text: John and his team supported each other and refused to quit during challenging games.

evidence.quote: We back each other up and won't quit.

facts.text: John and his team won a trophy as a result of their hard work and effort.
John expressed elation after winning the trophy and acknowledged the value of Tim's support.

evidence.quote: You must have been elated up there with that trophy. All the hard work paid off!
I was definitely elated. Your support really means a lot to me.
